lessonTitle: 41. Schwarz's lantern, or what is surface area
lessonTitleEnglish: Schwarz's lantern, or what is surface area
unit: Geometry · Chapter 9. Volumes and surfaces of solids of revolution
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 12 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: Curved surface area cannot be defined as the limit of inscribed polyhedra: Schwarz inscribed a «lantern» in a cylinder whose area can grow without bound.
stages.headlineEnglish: Curved surface area cannot be defined as the limit of inscribed polyhedra: Schwarz inscribed a «lantern» in a cylinder whose area can grow without bound.

stages.headline: The right definition measures area by the volume of a thin layer of thickness d: S = lim V(layer) : d as d → 0.
stages.headlineEnglish: The right definition measures area by the volume of a thin layer of thickness d: S = lim V(layer) : d as d → 0.

stages.headline: For a ball (4/3)π(R + d)³ − (4/3)πR³ ≈ 4πR² · d, so the sphere has area 4πR², the derivative of the volume in R.
stages.headlineEnglish: For a ball (4/3)π(R + d)³ − (4/3)πR³ ≈ 4πR² · d, so the sphere has area 4πR², the derivative of the volume in R.
